Use case: precise-object-edit. One native high-resolution transparent PNG for WEST run frame 04. Edit IMAGE1 ONLY. Image1 is the exact frame04 placement and pose. Image2 W05v6 is the corrected shoulder/anatomy and chest-visible WEST camera reference ONLY, not a replacement pose. Image3 W03 further anchors the fixed front-visible camera/identity. Image4 is approved style.

Redraw only the upper torso, shoulder/sleeve connections and front waist so Image1 no longer changes to a back-shoulder/rear-waist view. Match Image2's front-visible WEST camera. Anatomical LEFT is the NEAR shoulder on SCREEN RIGHT just below-right of neck. Its scroll arm must sweep diagonally down-left ACROSS THE FRONT OF THE CHEST, elbow in front, forearm continuing to Image1's existing forward scroll hand. Its large sleeve must overlap/occlude part of chest collar/taiji ornament; do not force all chest decorations visible. Anatomical RIGHT is the FAR shoulder hidden on neck-left behind the chest. Its upper brush arm travels backward on the FAR side, occluded by the torso/near scroll sleeve, with only distal smaller far sleeve emerging at the rear edge to Image1's existing rear brush hand. Never connect the near visible shoulder to the brush hand. Exactly two continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist chains; no extra arm.

Keep the closer, partially gathered swing of frame04: forward scroll grip near x300,y585; rear brush grip near x550,y595. Do not extend the arms to the wider W05 reference pose.

HARD INVARIANTS from IMAGE1: head and hair silhouette/size/position, left-facing face, ribbon position, hip position, entire two-leg pose from hip through knees and ankles to boots, both foot/contact positions and shoe axes. Preserve current leg phase with every contour; do not borrow any leg from Image2 or Image3. Preserve Image1's two hand positions, its existing scroll and brush positions/angles/sizes, exactly two ink spirits near scroll and one butt tassel on brush. Preserve all accessories. Keep the same whole-canvas framing and character scale—NO enlarge, shrink, recenter or translate. Only the torso/shoulder construction changes. Keep the far rightmost ribbon end safely inside the existing canvas; if needed bend only that tip inward, no figure movement.

Polished black-gold brocade and teal Q-style materials unchanged. Blank scroll, no text. True transparent background; square canvas at least1024x1024 with transparent border around every ribbon/prop. Do not turn the head/body front-on, do not show the back torso, do not exchange hands or props. Output just the one corrected independent frame04.
